about: Answers of the deleted Python tools/build_provision_list.py on these inputs, recorded by running it under CPython 3.15 (openpyxl 3.1.5 for build_dataset). `check` says what the Rust port must match: exact = exit code, stdout, stderr and outputs; raised = the message of an uncaught BuildError, which the port prints as `error: <message>`; argparse = exit code and the text after `error:`; exit = exit code only (a Python traceback); help = exit code only. Paths are relative to the case folder, with `/` separators and LF line ends.
